island.title: Ashen Kiln
island.rule: A live timetable shifts a ring-rail train and a walking iron giant across the island while tempering anvils reforge your bolts into Skip, Scatter, or Lance.
island.feel: Twilight foundry clockwork over dark basalt and lava, full of roaring rails, tilting footsteps, and crisp anvil clangs.
island.arc: Learn Skip bolts and the timetable at Switchyard Camp, conquer the Ember Express and Iron Colossus in either order, survive the runaway train crash into the Great Kiln, earn Sunflare, and beat the Kilnmother.
moments: Flipping the switchboard shakes the floor as the train shifts onto the viaduct and the giant bridges the caldera.
Sprinting against howling wind along speeding train roofs, ducking tunnel arches, and dropping into lower cars.
Jumping mid-air between two moving trains across a lava canyon while shooting a track switch.
Steering the giant from behind its furnace eyes, then freezing a slime right in its swinging heart's path.
Riding the runaway train across the giant's braced arm to smash straight through the Great Kiln's obsidian wall.

ember_express.promise: A speeding iron train where wall-bouncing Skip shots, train momentum, roof winds, and parallel freight cars turn every carriage into a moving puzzle.
ember_express.power: Coupler Hook yanks heavy hitch pins from afar and boosts your lantern zip.
ember_express.arc: Teaches Skip wall bounces and Scatter spreads inside lower cars, moves onto gale-swept roofs for the Coupler Hook, jumps onto a parallel freight train for Lance bolts, and ends at the boiler cab.
ember_express.boss: The Engineer tests live temper swapping through coal volleys, brake lurches, a roof blow-off, and armored boiler chains.

iron_colossus.promise: The interior of a walking iron giant whose steady footsteps tilt whole rooms, sliding crates, foes, and molten slag across brass decks.
iron_colossus.power: Cleated Heat-Boots keep you steady on tilting floors and delay crumbling grates.
iron_colossus.arc: Starts in the tilting ankle boot, teaches trapping crates and cooling basalt bumpers, earns Heat-Boots at the knee, branches through both shoulders to the cockpit helm, and ends with a sprint out.
iron_colossus.boss: The Colossus Heart swings in the tilting ribcage, testing valve breaks and freezing slimes in its pendulum arc.

iron_collision.promise: A frantic runaway set piece chasing Hollow Wick across a viaduct, the giant's kneeling forearm, and the speeding locomotive roof.
iron_collision.arc: Opens with Skip track switching after Hollow Wick cuts the brake chain, blasts a cart across the giant's forearm with Scatter recoil, duels an iron phantom on the roof, and smashes the dam.
iron_collision.boss: The Iron Phantom mirrors your tempered shots on the speeding roof, testing counterplay and twin throttle locks.

great_kiln.promise: A vast basalt foundry where toggling heat flow between low and surge crusts lava paths or pours molten slag so you cast your own bridges.
great_kiln.power: Sunflare unleashes a wide radial burst that shatters obsidian seals and armor.
great_kiln.arc: Builds from blue mirrors and phantom arches to the Sunflare shrine, opens a heat-controlled casting wing of slag molds and updrafts, and unites all three tempers before the Kilnmother.
great_kiln.boss: The Kilnmother tests Sunflare and Lance armor breaks, cooled slag cover against cross beams, and temper swaps.
